# opnsense_core_tunable (Resource)

System tunables: sysctl values and boot-time loader settings (System > Settings > Tunables). OPNsense ships many tunables already; import an existing one by UUID instead of creating a duplicate. Destroying a tunable removes it from the configuration but does not reset the running value until reboot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Drop packets to closed ports instead of answering with RST.
resource "opnsense_core_tunable" "blackhole_tcp" {
  tunable     = "net.inet.tcp.blackhole"
  value       = "2"
  description = "Silently drop TCP to closed ports"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tunable` (String) Tunable name, e.g. `net.inet.tcp.blackhole`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `value` (String) Value to set. Empty uses the default value. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `default_value` (String) The system default for this tunable, if OPNsense knows it.
- `id` (String) UUID of the tunable.
- `type` (String) `w` for a runtime sysctl, `t` for a boot-time tunable, empty when unknown.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_core_tunable.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
